emma: Quick thread  QuantumLock (HSM vendor) wants to onboard their HSM-backed KMS to the marketplace and do a short joint announcement. They asked for a security validation window next week. Can we checklist owners? @rafael @priya @zane

 rafael: Security asks: HSM module cert (module ID + FIPS cert), firmware hash, key export policy (must be non-exportable), and attestation type (remote attestation preferred). Need mTLS CA bundle and preferred ciphers.

 priya: Legal/marketing: we'll need a co-marketing addendum and logo guidelines. Also ask partner to agree to our embargo window (48-72h). Draft press blurb pls.

 zane: Ops/devex: what connector shape? helm chart or agent? Need deployment matrix (ports, env), prometheus metrics port, and a staging image tag. For tests we can use HSM simulator if they can't share hardware.

 emma: Minimal deliverables for greenlight: 1) KMS OpenAPI or sample calls; 2) HSM attestation artifacts; 3) CA certs for mTLS; 4) staging image + SCIM/SAML test user.

 priya: I'll send the addendum template today. Also ask for trademarked logo SVG and short 2-line blurb.

 rafael: One more: request zeroization policy and tamper-evidence statement (pdf). Banks often require module model numbers.

 zane: I'll prepare a staging runbook and kick off connector-smoke tests once we have a staging image. @ops-bot, please queue when image arrives.

 ops-bot: CI: marketplace-connector-tests queued -> https://ci.redwood.example/runs/9123.

 emma: Action items: rafael (security email to QuantumLock) due Wed (3055620000); priya (addendum + blurb) due Wed; zane (staging playbook + tests) due Thu. I'll follow up with QuantumLock PM (Sofia). Hold announcement until attestation + legal signoff. :thumbsup:
